question: Can any limb of yoga truly serve as a means here?
premises: In reality no limb of yoga has the status of a means.
The own nature of this reality is without form.
It is without form because it is free from limitation.
inference: Since the reality is formless and unlimited, no yogic limb can function as a true means to it.
plain_english: In reality, no limb of yoga can serve as a means, for its own nature is formless, being free from all limitation.
